reasons.plausibility: Reactive element additions (like Hf) are well-known to improve oxide scale adhesion and durability in high-temperature coatings, making this proposal scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison under cyclic oxidation tests with clear metrics (spallation, thickness, time to failure) provides a straightforward way to confirm or refute the claim.
reasons.usefulness: Studying minor Hf doping is relevant for extending TBC lifespan and addresses a practical concern for high-temperature alloy performance, thus this hypothesis is highly valuable to test.
